### Added
- **`gitops.prereleases` lets an installation follow release candidates.** On, every component's `versionRange` and the self-management range admit pre-release versions: each version of the range without a pre-release gets `-0`, so `>=5.31.4 <6.0.0` renders `>=5.31.4-0 <6.0.0-0` and `0.x` renders `0.x-0`, with a `semverFilter` that admits only `X.Y.Z` and `X.Y.Z-rc.N` tags, so the branch builds pushed to the same repositories stay out. An exact pin (`1.2.3`, `=1.2.3`) and an exclusion (`!=1.2.3`) are left as written, and a range of those only gets no filter. A component released with this chart keeps its exact version, a range with its own `semverFilter` is left as written, and a range with no version (`*`) fails the render. Off by default: stable releases only.
